headline: **MLB Recap: Reds, Rays, and Rangers Secure Crucial Wins**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds secured a 9-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Andrew Abbott earning the win. Sal Stewart led the Reds' offense with a 4-hit performance, including a 12th home run of the season. In other action, the Tampa Bay Rays took down the Baltimore Orioles 5-3, with Jesse Scholtens earning the win and Ian Seymour notching the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Victor Vodnik, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation with the Colorado Rockies. The Houston Astros also suffered a setback, as Lance McCullers Jr. was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 16, 2026, with right shoulder inflammation.

The Cincinnati Reds bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Texas Rangers also made a crucial move, rallying past the Colorado Rockies 5-4 in a thrilling finish.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Twins in 4-1 Decision**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 4-1 victory over the Houston Astros, snapping their winning streak. Ryan Kreidler led the Astros' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Rally Past Rockies in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers edged out the Colorado Rockies 5-4, securing a crucial win. Ezequiel Duran led the Rangers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Victor Vodnik Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation.

top_news.title: **Reds Acquire RHP Zach McCambley in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley in a trade. McCambley joins the Reds after being dealt from the Miami Marlins.
